_doc: Tool-result envelope keys deliberately left untaught, each with a checkable reason. Read by tests/unit/web/composer/test_tool_result_envelope_gate.py, which fails on any 'pending' reason: every entry is an adjudicated decision (elspeth-e405ad7cd2). A fence must not outlive what it fences — the gate also fails when a fenced key becomes taught or stops shipping.

fenced.reason: Server-side control-coverage bookkeeping (CapabilityDeclaration) consumed only by the policy, availability and planner-aid modules; no composer authoring path reads it and the required-control admission gate rejects independently of anything the model infers from it, so teaching it invites second-guessing a judgment the server makes (ratified F3b, 2026-09-02).
